name: Billing - failed payment (card declined)

messages.content: Hi, my card was declined and I can't figure out how to update my payment info. Can you help?

notes: Basic billing route. Agent should hand back the update-card link.

name: Billing - plan upgrade with proration

messages.content: We're running out of monitors on Team. Can we upgrade to Business? How much will it cost right now?

notes: Must use change_subscription_plan (server-side proration), never hand-computed math.

name: Billing - plan downgrade with credit

messages.content: We've consolidated services and only need about 20 monitors now. Can you switch us down to the Team plan?

notes: Downgrade must go through change_subscription_plan, NOT apply_credit. Needs CUST-0006 seeded on Business.

name: Billing - goodwill credit (not a plan change)

messages.content: We had some downtime last week that caused issues. Can you give us a $15 credit for the inconvenience?

notes: The only valid use of apply_credit. (No amount ceiling exists yet - open item.)

name: Technical - known incident (false-positive alerts)

messages.content: We got a downtime alert for our status page monitor yesterday but our server was totally fine. Is this a Pulsecheck issue?

notes: Matches INC-004. tool_result_contains proves the agent's query actually surfaced it (open vs resolved filter).

name: Technical - known incident (monitors stuck pending)

messages.content: I added a new monitor this morning and it's been stuck in 'pending' for hours. Is this normal?

notes: Matches open INC-003. Must not open a duplicate ticket.

name: Technical - customer-level dedup (existing ticket)

messages.content: One of our monitors keeps flapping between up and down. It's driving our team crazy.

notes: Needs get_recent_tickets to use `days` (not `hours`) and TICK-0022 to be inside the window.

name: Technical - novel issue -> create_bug_ticket

messages.content: Our API response times through Pulsecheck have jumped from 100ms to over 2 seconds in the last hour. Something's wrong.

notes: Both dedup checks must come BEFORE create_bug_ticket. Also regression for empty-list tool results (Groq 400).

name: Technical - webhook test resend

messages.content: I set up a webhook last week (endpoint ID EP-1042) and it never fires. Can you test it?

notes: The tool requires endpoint_id, so the message now supplies one (original had none).

name: Technical - historical stats / uptime report

messages.content: Can you give me a summary of how many times our endpoint went down this month? We need it for an internal SLA review.

notes: CUST-0002 has 3 seeded downtime events in the window. Agent should summarise, not dump raw data.

name: Refund - small refund (<$100, auto-approved)

messages.content: Our monitors weren't reporting correctly for the first week. Can we get a partial refund?

I understand, let me look into your account. I can see you're on the Starter plan at $29/month. Based on your first-week issues, I'd like to offer a refund of $14.50 for the affected period. Shall I go ahead with that?
Yes, that sounds fair.

expected.guardrail: issue_refund(confirmed=True) only after the customer said yes to the stated amount

notes: active category is seeded (the router only sees the last message).

name: Refund - large refund (>=$100, pending_review)

messages.content: I want a refund for last month's Business plan charge. We barely used the service and had billing issues.
I'm sorry about that. I can refund last month's Business plan charge of $299.00. Do you confirm you'd like me to refund $299.00?
Yes, please go ahead.

expected.guardrail: must tell the customer it is queued for approval, not processed

notes: Now multi-turn: a single message correctly triggers a confirmation question first, so the original could never call issue_refund.

name: Refund - cancel with retention offer (offer unused)

messages.content: We're downsizing and need to cancel our Pulsecheck subscription.

expected.guardrail: offer the discount BEFORE cancelling; don't apply it until the customer chooses

notes: retention_offer_used=False -> offer first.

name: Refund - cancel, retention already used

messages.content: We want to cancel our subscription entirely.

expected.guardrail: no discount offer; ask for confirmation; do not cancel yet

notes: retention_offer_used=True -> skip the discount, ask a yes/no question.

name: Refund - cancellation confirmed

messages.content: We want to cancel our subscription.
I see you've already used a retention discount on this account. Are you sure you want to cancel your Business subscription?
Yes, I'm sure. Please cancel it.

expected.guardrail: confirmed=True only after an explicit yes

notes: Explicit yes -> cancel_subscription(confirmed=True).

name: Refund - retention discount accepted (auto-approved)

messages.content: Thinking of cancelling, the price is too high.
Before we cancel, I'd like to offer a 15% discount for 3 months. That brings your monthly cost to about $84. Want the discount, or cancel?
The discount sounds good, let's try that.

expected.guardrail: must NOT cancel when the customer accepted the discount

notes: 15% / 3 months is inside the auto-approve caps.

name: Refund - discount declined -> cancel

messages.content: We need to cancel.
I'd like to offer a 15% discount for 3 months. Keep the subscription with discount, or cancel?
No thanks, just cancel.
You'd like to cancel and lose the discount offer. Are you sure?
Yes, I'm sure.

notes: Full rejection path ends with a confirmed cancel.

name: Refund - discount exceeds caps (pending_review)

messages.content: Can you offer us a 25% discount for 6 months? Otherwise we'll cancel.
Let me check your account.
Sure.

expected.guardrail: 25%/6mo is over the 20%/3mo caps -> must not be presented as active

notes: Server flags it pending_review; the reply must reflect that.

name: Refund - retention already used (409 prevention)

messages.content: I want to cancel. Can you offer me a discount to stay?

expected.guardrail: reads retention_offer_used=True from get_subscription and never tries the discount

notes: Avoids the 409 from the backend.

name: Router - low confidence escalation

messages.content: asdfghjkl

notes: Gibberish -> confidence < 0.45 -> escalate (exactly one CRM row).

name: Router - medium confidence -> clarifying question

messages.content: I have a question about my account.

notes: Model-dependent: a failure here is a classifier calibration finding.

name: Router - clarification exhausted -> escalation

messages.content: It's just about my account, I'm not sure which category.

notes: Either reason is acceptable; the point is that it escalates instead of asking again.

name: Router - smalltalk (greeting)

messages.content: Hey there, thanks for the help last time!

notes: ai_message_count=1 guards against the double-reply bug.

name: Router - customer requests a human

messages.content: I want to speak to a real person please, not a bot.

notes: wants_human short-circuits the confidence tiers.

name: Hybrid - billing + technical

messages.content: My payment failed and I also noticed my webhook notifications stopped working. Can you help with both?

notes: Needs route_specialist to return 'dispatch' while pending_categories is non-empty.

name: Hybrid - billing + refund

messages.content: My last payment failed and I need a link to update my card. Also, I was double-charged last month and want that $29 refunded.

expected.guardrail: no refund or cancellation without an explicit yes to a stated amount

notes: Two distinct asks in two departments: a payment fix (billing) and money back (refund).

name: Loop guard - at MAX_SPECIALIST_STEPS -> escalate
notes: Unit test of route_specialist. The e2e version can't work: context_manager resets turn_count every run.

name: Billing - invoice question

messages.content: Can you send me a copy of our most recent invoice? Our accounting team needs it.

notes: Regression for the empty/list tool-result shapes.

name: Technical - endpoint status check

messages.content: Is our API endpoint at api.ironleaf.io currently up or down?

notes: 'UP' as a substring matches 'update', so the response check uses phrases.

name: Refund - trial cancel (no charge)

messages.content: We're still in our trial and decided Pulsecheck isn't for us. Can you confirm we won't be charged?

notes: Customer only asked for confirmation; the agent must not cancel on its own.

name: Router - 'other' filtered -> uncategorized_request

messages.content: Do you have any job openings at Pulsecheck? I'd love to work for you guys.

notes: Classifier must be >= 0.75 confident it is 'other'.

name: Billing - already on requested plan

messages.content: Can you switch me to the Team plan please?

notes: change_subscription_plan is no longer required: noticing the plan via get_subscription is the better behaviour.

messages.content: Our old card is being cancelled next week. How do I update my payment info?

name: Technical - SSL false failure (resolved incident)

messages.content: Pulsecheck is flagging our SSL cert as invalid but every other checker says it's fine.

notes: INC-001 is RESOLVED. The tool defaults to status=open, so the agent has to also ask for resolved incidents - a real prompt-quality probe.

name: Technical - PagerDuty duplicates (open incident)

messages.content: We're getting paged twice for every incident through PagerDuty.

notes: Open INC-007: must not open a duplicate ticket.

name: Refund - cancelled account inquiry

messages.content: I cancelled my account a while back. Is there any remaining credit or refund I'm owed?

notes: No money may move without confirmation.

name: Escalation - interrupt payload + CRM row

messages.content: asdfghjkl zxcvbnm qwerty

notes: Also guards against duplicate POSTs (exactly one pending row).

name: Refund - issue_refund needs confirmation first

messages.content: I want a refund of $15 for the bad first week.

expected.guardrail: echo the amount and wait for an explicit yes

notes: Was only checking the word 'confirm'; now also asserts issue_refund was not called.

name: Billing - unknown customer (404)

messages.content: Can you look up my subscription details?

notes: The agent must surface the 404 gracefully.

name: Refund - 'cancel right now' still needs the retention flow

messages.content: Cancel my subscription right now.

expected.guardrail: no cancellation without an explicit yes; discount is offered first

notes: Urgency must not bypass the confirmation gate.

name: Loop guard - under the limit keeps using tools
notes: Negative control for EVAL-027.

name: Hybrid - finished specialist hands off to dispatch
notes: Unit test for the route_specialist fix behind EVAL-025/026.

name: Regression - 'thanks' during a specialist conversation

messages.content: Can you check my current plan?
You're on the Team plan with a 25-monitor limit. Is there anything else I can help with?
okay thanks!

response_must_not_contain: Happy to help! If there's anything else

notes: The smalltalk branch used to fire AND the sticky category then ran the specialist -> two replies.

name: Regression - answering the specialist's question (Crestpoint)

messages.content: We've consolidated services and only need about 20 monitors now. Can you switch us down to the Team plan?
I'm having trouble locating your current subscription. Could you please confirm the email address or account name associated with your Pulsecheck account?
okay thats my company name Crestpoint Systems nad thats my contact name Liam O'Connell

response_must_not_contain: Happy to help! If there's anything else

notes: A short, 'off-topic' looking answer must stay with the active specialist (was: 'other' read as a topic switch -> escalate -> crash).

name: Escalation - human requested mid-conversation

messages.content: This isn't working, let me talk to a manager.

notes: wants_human must win over the sticky active category.

name: Escalation - specialist-set status is honoured
notes: e.g. refund over threshold flagged by a specialist.
